title: A photorealistic cinematic vertical mirr
prompt:
A photorealistic cinematic vertical mirror-selfie portrait of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing in a narrow bedroom or dressing area between warm pinkish wood wardrobe panels. Her specific ethnicity or race should remain unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has light-to-medium skin with neutral-warm undertones, realistic natural texture, subtle highlights on her shoulders, arms, waist, and thighs, and soft indoor illumination mixed with cool ambient daylight.

Her face is largely concealed by a black smartphone held vertically directly in front of her face with her right hand. Only small portions of her forehead, cheeks, and lower facial contours remain visible, so her eye color and precise expression are mostly hidden. Her posture conveys a relaxed, self-assured mirror-selfie attitude. She has long, thick, dark brown to nearly black hair, parted near the center, falling in softly layered lengths around her face, shoulders, and upper chest, with slightly tousled natural volume.

She wears a fitted olive-green lace camisole-style crop top with thin spaghetti straps, floral lace patterning, scalloped lace trim, a deep V neckline, and structured bust shaping. The top ends above the navel, exposing her midriff and waist. She pairs it with very short black faux-leather shorts featuring a low-to-mid rise waist, glossy textured finish, front button closure, belt loops, visible front pockets, and close-fitting leg openings. Do not add jackets, stockings, jewelry, belts, or additional layers.

Her body is framed from the upper head down to the upper thighs. She stands mostly straight with her weight subtly shifted through one hip, left arm relaxed naturally beside her body while the right arm is raised to hold the phone. The mirror creates an intimate, casual domestic composition.

The background should faithfully evoke a compact lived-in room: pale blue-gray wall, an older white window-mounted air-conditioning unit high behind her, a dark window opening beneath it, miscellaneous small household items, and wardrobe interiors partly visible along the left edge. Use a realistic smartphone-camera perspective equivalent to roughly 26–30mm, moderate depth of field, sharp focus on the reflected subject, restrained dynamic range, slightly cool shadows, muted earthy greens and blacks, soft pink-brown wood tones, subtle digital grain, and natural low-key cinematic color grading. 9:16.
